2607.11287.title: A Unified Framework for Comprehensive Cardiac CT Segmentation and Phenotyping: Human-in-the-Loop Data Annotation, Vision Foundation Model Development, Multicenter Evaluation and Clinical Validation
2607.11287.paper_summary: Comprehensive quantification of cardiac structures from computed tomography (CT) remains limited not by data availability but by the scalability of measurements, which makes routine use impractical. Here we present a unified framework for comprehensive cardiac CT segmentation and phenotyping that combines a human-in-the-loop annotation pipeline, a cardiac CT augmentation technique, and a self-supervised foundation model pre-trained on 60,000 unlabeled cardiac CT scans. Using this approach, we assembled the largest and most comprehensive expert-annotated cardiac CT segmentation dataset to date, comprising 1598 cases and 14 distinct cardiac structures (1000 for training, 598 for the external test set). Across five external datasets, the framework segmented all structures more accurately and comprehensively than existing open-source tools. Self-supervised pre-training improved labeling efficiency, with the most significant gains observed during external evaluation in the low-data regime. Benchmarking across convolutional, transformer, and state-space architectures showed comparable performance, indicating that data quality and pre-training, rather than architecture, drove accuracy. The framework was scaled to population-level phenotyping, with segmented anatomy that carries functionally relevant information about ventricular function and disease severity beyond demographic variables. By openly releasing the largest dataset with human labels, code, model weights, a CT augmentation library, and software, this work provides a reproducible foundation for opportunistic cardiac phenotyping from routinely acquired CT scans.
2607.11287.paper_summary_zh: 全面量化心臟結構的計算機斷層掃描（CT）仍然受到測量可擴展性的限制，而非數據可用性的限制，這使得常規使用變得不切實際。<lb/>在此，我們提出了一個統一的框架，用於全面的心臟CT分割和表型分析，該框架結合了人機協作的標註流程、一種心臟CT增強技術，以及在60,000個未標註心臟CT掃描上預訓練的自我監督基礎模型。<lb/>使用這種方法，我們組建了迄今為止最大的、最全面的專家標註心臟CT分割數據集，該數據集包含1598個案例和14個不同的心臟結構（1000個用於訓練，598個用於外部測試集）。<lb/>在五個外部數據集上，該框架比現有的開源工具更準確和全面地分割所有結構。<lb/>自我監督的預訓練提高了標註效率，在低數據環境下的外部評估中觀察到最顯著的增益。<lb/>在卷積、Transformer和狀態空間架構之間的基準測試顯示出可比的性能，這表明數據質量和預訓練，而非架構，驅動了準確性。<lb/>該框架擴展到人口層面的表型分析，分割的解剖結構攜帶有關心室功能和疾病嚴重性的功能相關信息，超越了人口統計變量。<lb/>通過公開發布擁有人工標籤的最大數據集、代碼、模型權重、CT增強庫和軟件，這項工作為從常規獲取的CT掃描中進行機會性心臟表型分析提供了一個可重複的基礎。
